scope: Deterministic regression coverage for bounded performance, provider/model/parser/storage failures, analysis failures, AI budgets, and retry behavior.

fixturePolicy.data: Synthetic test fixtures only; no fixture is persisted as a research result.
fixturePolicy.scientificClaims: None; analysis failure assertions check explicit failure states and empty result arrays.

assertions: result count is bounded by k
workload completes within the test safety budget
maximum accepted chunk count is enforced
duplicate extraction calls are not introduced
exactly three provider calls are attempted
provider error is not reported as success
review route is blocked before provider use
parser status is Failed with diagnostic
storage remains Local / Unpersisted with no metadata record
analysis status is Failed with no p-values/effect sizes

verification.runtimeMeasurements: The test records a bounded retrieval timing check; no fabricated benchmark duration is persisted in this report.
